title: AI in 2026: What It Can Really Do
description: Explore the real capabilities of AI in 2026, from creative collaboration to everyday life. A quick, engaging look at the tech shaping our future.

scenes.narration: Welcome to 2026, AI everywhere. Today we uncover its true power.
scenes.image_prompt: A bustling neon‑lit city skyline at dusk, skyscrapers with holographic billboards, drones flying overhead, pedestrians in smart wearables, reflections on glass, cinematic lighting, high detail.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow dolly from street level up to cityscape, slight upward tilt, ambient city sounds, subtle motion blur.

scenes.narration: AI composes music that feels real. Symphonies are written in milliseconds.
scenes.image_prompt: A sleek studio with floating hologram of a composer, levitating instruments, AI interface glowing, musician wearing futuristic headphones, ambient synth lighting, ultra‑realistic textures.
scenes.motion_prompt: Smooth pan across the studio, focus shift from hologram to musician, subtle light flicker, camera follows instrument movement.

scenes.narration: It predicts health issues early. Your data is its playbook.
scenes.image_prompt: A futuristic home interior with transparent health monitor walls, virtual assistant projecting health stats, family interacting, soft ambient glow, polished surfaces, hyper‑realistic details.
scenes.motion_prompt: Track from wall to assistant, gentle zoom in, soft pulse animation, camera pans to family members, subtle camera shake.

scenes.narration: AI handles errands with care. From groceries to repairs, it's unseen.
scenes.image_prompt: Domestic setting: kitchen counter with AI kitchen assistant, robot arm cooking, smartphone displaying orders, pet dog watching, warm kitchen light, realistic textures, cinematic composition.
scenes.motion_prompt: Camera follows robot arm, then pans to smartphone, final wide shot of household, smooth dolly, slight tilt, subtle ambient sounds.
